invariants.title: Every financial row belongs to a folio
Daily collections equal the direct payments recorded for the day
Every stored tax line equals its taxable base times its rate
No financial row was created into a business date after that date closed
Every frozen night-audit snapshot matches its stored hash
Recomputing a closed day reproduces the figures it reported
A payment is never dated outside the stay it belongs to
A walk-in reservation is never settled through an OTA receivable
